segments.en: Hello.
Tell me, who is speaking?
I am Karthik, who is this?
I am Madhuri, what is your name?
Karthik, what is your name?
I am not Rani, what do you do?
I am working as a team head in a company.
What about you?
I am working in a real estate company.
Is that so? Are you single?
I am married and have a son. What about you?
I am single. I am 26 years old.
I am 36.
Okay, okay. You are 10 years older than me.
Okay, okay.
Tell me.
Tell me, why did you come to this app?
I didn't understand.
Why did you come to this app?
I just came here. Why are you asking me for the second time?
Okay, okay.
I just came to talk. Why, what happened?
I asked you why you came here. Everyone has a purpose. I came here for a good friend. Everyone has a purpose, so I wanted to know.
How is this app?
I don't know, I don't come here often.
Is that so? Okay.
What happened? You don't sound okay.
Nothing, I just felt a bit upset. I thought I would talk to someone. Talking to a stranger is better.
Oh, is that so? Okay, okay.
What about you?
I told you, I came here for a friend.
How is everyone at home?
Everyone is fine. Is everyone fine at your home?
Yes, everyone is fine.
What does your husband do?
My husband is busy with his work.
Why are you not talking?
Yes, some people stay separately after marriage. We are married and staying separately.
Why, what happened?
Yes, there are some money problems and understanding problems at home, so we are staying separately.
Why don't you stay together in the same house?
Are you angry with him?
Why would I be angry? If we talk, there will be a fight. If we don't talk, there won't be a fight.
We are busy with our work. I am working in a real estate company.
Okay, okay. Okay, okay.
If you stay alone at home, you will be more depressed.
What do your children do?
He is studying in 11th grade.
He is studying in 11th grade.
Okay, okay.
Tell me.
You tell me.
Where are you?
I am in a Chennai-based company in Coimbatore.
Okay, okay.
Is it HR?
It's not HR, it's a team head role. Companies give us projects and we manage them.
Oh, okay, okay. You have to manage people under you.
Yes, there are 26-30 people under me. I have to plan how to do the work.
Is it a software company or something else?
It's a software company.
Is it Zoho software?
Yes, yes.
Okay, okay.
Most of the team heads have financial level work in the bank line. I have worked there before, so I asked.
You are talking about telecalling, right?
No, there is telecalling and team head. There are team leaders and team managers.
Yes, there is telecalling and collection, something like that.
This is about going directly to the customer and managing the software efficiently.
Okay, okay, okay, okay.
Tell me.
You tell me, you have to say something.
Are you into sales?
Are you into sales?
Yes, I am a friend of a sir. We both together sell projects of other companies.
On a commission basis.
Okay, okay.
How is it? Is it 10% or 20%?
It depends on the company. In Coimbatore, it is usually 2%.
Usually, it is 2%. We get 2% from the customer side.
The owner gives a company project based on the location. If it is far or expensive, they give 7%, 5%, or 3%.
If it is more, it will be 2%. If it is less, it will increase accordingly.
If a cent is 8-9 lakhs, it is difficult to sell that place.
No one buys a cent for 8 lakhs. They buy a flat for 8 lakhs, 2-3 cents.
If we finish that place, he will give 7%.
It is rare to finish. If we finish other places, he will give 2% or 3%. We get 2% from the customer side.
Okay, okay.
There is some land in Kanchipuram, but I don't know how it is. I have been thinking about it for a long time.
There is only one ground.
Is it in Kanchipuram?
It is in Coimbatore, right?
Yes, but the land is in Kanchipuram.
How much is the rate?
I don't know, they are asking for 5 lakhs in the house.
5 lakhs?
Yes, 5 lakhs.
How many cents is it?
I don't know, I think it is 1600 square feet.
I know a friend in Coimbatore who is in real estate, so I asked.
Okay.
I asked if I could tell them, nothing else.
Two people are working there in the real estate company.
My house is in two minds. One says sell it, another says don't sell it. My husband says sell it.
I can't do anything. If you want to sell it with one mind, we can tell someone to process it.
That's what I said.
I only get leads for Madurai, so I will put it for Madurai.
My friends are in Chennai and they are also doing real estate. If someone asks for Chennai, I will tell them.
If someone asks for Coimbatore, I will tell them, that's it.
They have some clients there. If we tell them and it is okay for them, they will finish it.
If there is some income, it is okay.
Okay, okay.
What did you eat?
I ate sambar chicken.
Sambar chicken in Neyyattinkara?
Yes.
Is it different?
I have heard of Madurai sambar chicken, but sambar chicken in Neyyattinkara is okay.
I always eat rice at night.
Are you at home or in a hostel?
I am at home.
Sambar chicken is good for lunch. For night, chicken...
I rarely go to hotels. Once a year, they take me to a hotel.
No, that's okay. That's okay. Most people eat sambar chicken for lunch. Some people eat rasam and chicken at night.
We also eat like that.
Good habit, good boy.
Are you joining the certificate?
I am telling you.
Usually, everyone expects this and that. If you say you will eat anything, you are a good boy. It's a good sign for your future wife.
They will cook and give it to me.
I told you, you are a good boy.
I am learning to cook at home.
You have to learn. I used to do non-veg before. I am good at it. I have been teaching him for a long time.
The future wife shouldn't scold us.
I told her that I will teach you, so don't scold me.
I told you, the future wife shouldn't ask what kind of child you have raised.
